verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions and an MCP server, so this axis applies to it. Nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The general API docs show the API exists but not that it is versioned or governed by a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
